QUOTE: `library/memory_buffer_alloc.c` (around line 572) is an optional built-in arena allocator, enabled by `MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C`. Its `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` itself, installing its own calloc and free.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator and says its init function calls the runtime setter to install itself. It doesn't say outright that this is the only in-tree user, but "The library's own use of the facility is mostly as a hook point for its optional built-in arena allocator" points that way.
